name: Invisibility Cloak
description_html:
Ever wonder if Harry Potter could have used his Dad’s cloak in more fun ways? Maybe you want to hunt Killa and watch him run aimlessly while you gun him down Or maybe you need some of those pesky bolt-action kills: If you want to be heard but not seen, this is the mod for you!

Enemies will not see you, will not shoot you, and will simply run away when shot, completely unaware who or what shot them.

To install, copy the DLL into your ‘\Escape From Tarkov\BepInEx\plugins\’ folder and start the game.

You will be invisible by default - which can be turned off by using the in-game tilde (`) command ‘invisible_off’
